    ex job_ok() == "ok"

def job_empty() -> str uses none:
    """Return the empty string; used as a sample job."""
    ex job_empty() == ""
    return ""

def wrapped(job: Callable[[], str]) -> str uses none:
    """Run job and return its result wrapped as start:<result>:end.

    The helper performs no I/O and logs nothing. Any capabilities needed
    by job are the closure's own concern and are not granted here.
    """
    post out.startswith("start:") and out.endswith(":end")
    ex wrapped(job_ok) == "start:ok:end"
    ex wrapped(job_empty) == "start::end"
    return "start:" + job() + ":end"
